FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(SOUTH KLANG VALLEY EXPRESSWAY) (AMENDMENT) ORDER 2024

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (South Klang Valley Expressway) (Amendment) Order 2024.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 31 August 2024.

Amendment of paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls)

(South Klang Valley Expressway) Order 2013 [P.U. (A) 309/2013], which is referred to

as the "principal Order" in this Order, is amended in paragraph 2 by substituting for

subparagraph (1) the following subparagraph:

"(1) SKVE Holding Sdn. Bhd. is authorized for the period from 31 August 2024

to 20 November 2047 to demand, collect and retain the appropriate tolls specified

in column (2) of the First Schedule at the toll plaza specified in column (1), for the

use in either direction of any part of the road known as—

(a) South Klang Valley Expressway (SKVE) commencing from

kilometre 7.95 South Klang Valley Expressway (SKVE)

at coordinates N 329205.067, E 407802.677 of the Rectified Skew

Orthormorphic Grid (RSO) and ending at kilometre 52.98 at

coordinate N 322991.422, E 370720.880 of the RSO Grid

(both distances measured from UNITEN Interchange), including

Ayer Hitam Toll Plaza, SKVE Saujana Putra Interchange,

SKVE Saujana Putra Toll Plaza, Teluk Panglima Garang Interchange,

Teluk Panglima Garang Toll Plaza, Pulau Indah Toll Plaza,

Pulau Indah Interchange and Tanjung Dua Belas Interchange,

being a distance of 45.03 kilometre;

(b) the part of the road known as the Link Road commencing from

Tanjung Dua Belas Interchange, SKVE at the coordinate

N 322335.441, E 390787.441 and N 322296.425, E 390243.823

until Limit of the Maintenance at the coordinate N 323416.366,

E 390990.512 RSO Grid, being a distance of 1.47 kilometre; and

(c) the part of the road known as the West Coast Expressway

(Taiping-Banting) (WCE) commencing from kilometre 0.00 at

coordinates N 314037.031, E 395567.983 of the RSO Geocentric

(GDM 2000) Grid and ending at kilometre 12.51 at coordinates

N 324492.234, E 391350.504 RSO Geocentric (GDM 2000) Grid

(both distances measured from kilometre 0.0 of the West Coast

Expressway (Taiping-Banting) (WCE) at Banting Interchange)

including Banting Interchange, Banting Toll Plaza, SKVE

Interchange and its link roads, being a distance of 12.51 kilometre,

by the classes of vehicles specified in column (2).

Substitution of First Schedule

the following schedule:
